---
title: "Gaps and contributing"
---

## What does not work yet

The [capability map](capabilities.qmd) has the full picture. In short:

- Fitted (R3') grids and meshes (R4, R5) do not warp yet; features (R6)
  are queries for extraction, not data the model holds.
- netCDF is read only through a byte-reference table, not directly; CF
  `grid_mapping` and 1D CF bounds are not read.
- `wxy-virtual` does not yet handle LZW or predictors, `s3://`
  references, or tables with several chunks per file.
- CRS work uses the pure-Rust proj4rs backend: EPSG codes and PROJ
  strings, no datum grids, no WKT (see [CRS input](crs-input.md)).
- The Python and R packages warp in-memory arrays only. Nothing is
  published to crates.io, PyPI or CRAN.

Which stages are planned next, and why, is in design doc 03's
[stages section](design/docs/03-architecture.md#3-stages).

## Ways to help

- **Contribute a fixture.** A small file plus the GDAL output it should
  produce is the most useful way to pin a behaviour down. See
  [wxylib/fixtures](https://github.com/wxylib/fixtures).
- **Report a GDAL mismatch.** The bar is identity: every warp, point read
  and polygon case must give GDAL's numbers exactly. A case that does not
  is a bug in [wxylib/core](https://github.com/wxylib/core/issues).
- **Question the design.** Each design document ends in a gate, so the
  open questions are written down. Open an issue on
  [wxylib/design](https://github.com/wxylib/design/issues).
- **Write a how-to.** Each one starts from a question asked on a forum or
  issue tracker and answers it with a command or a live page.
- **Prefer upstream.** If a fix belongs in async-tiff, zarrs, Icechunk,
  rwarp or the GeoZarr conventions, it goes there; wxylib keeps only what
  has no other home.

## Repositories

| Repository | Holds |
|------------|-------|
| [design](https://github.com/wxylib/design) | Design documents, roadmap and decisions |
| [core](https://github.com/wxylib/core) | The Cargo workspace |
| [fixtures](https://github.com/wxylib/fixtures) | Test files and GDAL oracle outputs |
| [docs](https://github.com/wxylib/docs) | This site |
| [py](https://github.com/wxylib/py), [r](https://github.com/wxylib/r) | Early Python and R bindings |
| [web](https://github.com/wxylib/web) | The browser demos |
| [images](https://github.com/wxylib/images) | Container images for the CLI, Python and R |
